# RefactorKit 0.8.0

This release targets ISO C11 and C17 on Linux x86-64 with reusable Clang
infrastructure. API 0.2 remains the compatibility baseline.

- C analysis uses the captured compilation database and its per-translation-unit
  flags, headers and ownership. Managed refactoring applies a reviewed preview
  with explicit approval and records a transaction for rollback.
- The Linux archive includes its Java runtime. C analysis requires an explicitly
  configured external Clang, clangd and clang-format toolchain. The C guide
  describes the reference toolchain and the assessed operation and surface boundaries.
- Other hosts remain **NOT VERIFIED** for 0.8.0. Multi-host qualification is
  scheduled for 1.0.0. The 0.8.0 scope covers C.

[C guide](https://github.com/mgiustiniani/refactorkit/blob/v0.8.0/docs/c-language.md) ·

## Asset verification

The draft holds the runtime ZIP, its SHA-256 checksum, the SPDX inventory and the
source-bound release manifest. The separate Linux review job verifies the
downloaded workflow artifacts and their attestations and runs the embedded CLI
and MCP server. Independent review of the draft and public download verification
are recorded at their respective stages.
